answer: Proof-of-stake identity is the trellis: every agent locks a slashable bond recorded in a layered shale ledger. An attacker building a dune of Sybil clones must post collateral for each one, so attack cost rises linearly with clone count. Caught double-signing, the bond is burned, while honest agents reuse a single stake across many tasks. A thousand fake workers therefore need a thousand separate stakes, which makes the Sybil swarm unprofitable.
